normativeStrength.INVARIANT: Architecture/product truth; implementation cannot violate without ADR/product decision.
normativeStrength.V1_REQUIRED: Required for the owning phase/release boundary.
normativeStrength.V1_CHOICE: Replaceable implementation choice inside defined interface.
normativeStrength.DEFERRED: Not required unless promoted by ADR and acceptance change.

git.durabilityBoundary: Every meaningful coherent checkpoint must be published to GitHub; direct local git push is optional when a GitHub connector/API is the available transport.
git.checkpoint: Publish after each completed roadmap task or coherent working checkpoint, and before risky change, handoff or session end.
git.historyRewrite: Forbidden on published shared branches without explicit authorization.

ci.principle: Use GitHub Actions aggressively for independent deterministic verification, matrices, packaging and security; optimize for confidence, not minute conservation.
ci.liveRouteProvider: P048-P049 only in operator-controlled live environment; not a public-CI dependency.
ci.executionModes: Local agents run focused local tests plus Actions; connector-only agents use Actions/available remote verification and must not claim nonexistent local execution.

module.securityClaim: operator-trusted same-user executable code; process boundary is not an adversarial sandbox
module.candidateRule: last-known-good active package/state survives candidate failure

routing.chromiumForwarder: distinct loopback-only command/lease; do not weaken authenticated Firefox-compatible prepare_exit path

operation.uncertainRetry: Reconcile before re-dispatch; no blind automatic duplicate mutation.

storage.browserProfiles: browser-owned filesystem state, not normalized DB rows
storage.migrationRule: ordered immutable migration IDs/checksums; destructive migrations require safety backup

secrets.preferredBackend: Linux Secret Service/libsecret-compatible credential store subject to acceptance

testing.githubActionsSecrets: No real Perchance/Mullvad/browser-session credentials or WireGuard private configs are required for CI.
testing.perchance: Use evidence-backed emulator/fixtures for phase gating; real provider only P12.
testing.routing: Use synthetic network/SOCKS/WireGuard fixtures for phase gating; real Mullvad only P12.
testing.mcp: Not required to close P001-P047; final interoperability/system acceptance only in P048-P049.
testing.driftRule: When live behavior disagrees with emulator, encode the observation into emulator/regression CI before continuing live debugging.

execution.phaseUnit: one structurally bounded cloud-agent session; empirical target approximately 20-30 minutes
execution.agentTimeAwareness: Do not depend on elapsed-time awareness; enforce size through phase scope.
execution.completion: Close/test/report/publish current phase, mark only immediate successor READY, then STOP.
